description: A Mould Maker is responsible for the design, manufacture, and assembly of various moulds and dies, including injection moulds, compression moulds, and die-casting dies. This role requires expertise in advanced machining processes, CAD/CAM software, quality control, and the ability to troubleshoot and repair. Upon successful completion, learners will be qualified to become Die Makers for manufacturing dies, moulds, special purpose tools, and die-casting dies. They will gain employment opportunities in engineering, manufacturing, machine tools, automobile, and general machinery industries. This
